# Refresh CodebaseOverview.md component inventory to the Neo.setupClass counting rule and link from benefit pages

## Context

Sub-issue of `#20498` implementing **Row 14 (`inventory-single-source`)** of the three-reader `learn/` map ([`#20498#issuecomment-6697670393`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20498#issuecomment-6697670393) & [`#20518#issuecomment-6700350274`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20518#issuecomment-6700350274)).

- **Ownership disposition:** `unowned-rationale: claimable leaf under #20498 per map #issuecomment-6697670393 (delegated filing by @neo-fable-mnemosyne)`

## The Problem

`learn/guides/fundamentals/CodebaseOverview.md` ("Understanding the Scale", dated *"State of May 1, 2026"*, and §"Component Library (The Batteries)", lines `255–290`) is the public inventory ranked first by `ask_knowledge_base` for *"what does Neo ship"*, but:
1. Its inventory numbers are stale as of May 1, 2026 (`20+` form field types where `src/form/field/` has `26` concrete field classes today; omits `src/dashboard/`'s `44` docking classes and `src/grid/header/GroupRow.mjs`).
2. It does not state the canonical reproducible counting rule (`grep -rl Neo.setupClass src --include='*.mjs'`), which led earlier drafts to count raw `.mjs` files (`520` files including `24` `_export.mjs` barrels and `11` `form/field/trigger/*` classes) instead of actual `Neo.setupClass` classes (`459` classes in `39` namespaces).

Design authority: `#20498` + `#20498#issuecomment-6697670393` (Row 14 `inventory-single-source`) + `#20518#issuecomment-6700350274`.

## The Architectural Reality

- **One Counting Rule, Stated Once (`#20518#issuecomment-6700350274`):**
  - A **class** is a file under `src/` that calls `Neo.setupClass` (`grep -rl Neo.setupClass src --include='*.mjs' | wc -l` → **`459` classes in `39` namespaces**; `_export.mjs` barrels, mixins-only files, and non-class modules do not count).
  - A **form field type** is a concrete class under `src/form/field/` outside `trigger/` and the internals (`chip/`, `fileUpload/`), `Base` excluded (**`26` field types**: `CheckBox`, `Chip`, `Color`, `ComboBox`, `Country`, `Currency`, `Date`, `Display`, `Email`, `FileUpload`, `Hidden`, `IBAN`, `Number`, `Password`, `Phone`, `Picker`, `Radio`, `Range`, `Search`, `Select`, `Switch`, `Text`, `TextArea`, `Time`, `Url`, `ZipCode`).
  - **Grid:** **`38` classes** (`src/grid/` — locked columns, `header/GroupRow` header groups, cell editing, animated rows, tree/sparkline/progress/currency columns, buffered rows to `100,000`).
  - **Other major namespaces:** Calendar (`28`), dashboard docking (`44`), selection models (`24`), draggable (`14`), data (`17`), list (`9`), tab (`7`), table (`6`), layouts (`8` — `Card`, `Cube`, `Fit`, `Flexbox`, `Form`, `Grid`, `HBox`, `VBox`), main-thread addons (`38` in `src/main/addon/`).
- Every benefits page that references the component inventory should link `learn/guides/fundamentals/CodebaseOverview.md` instead of maintaining a separate per-family census.

## The Fix

1. Update `learn/guides/fundamentals/CodebaseOverview.md` ("Understanding the Scale" and §"Component Library (The Batteries)"):
   - State the reproducible `Neo.setupClass` counting rule explicitly so any reader or agent can re-verify the numbers with one command.
   - Refresh all family counts and descriptions to current `dev` (`459` classes in `39` namespaces, `26` form field types, `38` grid classes including `header/GroupRow`, `44` dashboard docking classes, `28` calendar classes, `24` selection models, `8` layouts, `38` main-thread addons).
2. Cross-link `learn/guides/fundamentals/CodebaseOverview.md` from `learn/benefits/body/ApplicationEngine.md` and `learn/benefits/body/Features.md` as the single source of truth for the component inventory.

## Contract Ledger

| Target surface | Source of authority | Proposed behavior | Fallback / edge case | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `learn/guides/fundamentals/CodebaseOverview.md` + `learn/benefits/body/{ApplicationEngine,Features}.md` | `#20498#issuecomment-6697670393` Row 14 + `#20518#issuecomment-6700350274` | State the `Neo.setupClass` counting rule in `CodebaseOverview.md`, refresh the inventory to current `dev` (`459` classes, `26` field types, `38` grid, `44` dashboard, `8` layouts, `38` addons), and link `CodebaseOverview.md` from benefit pages | Re-verify counts at `HEAD` before commit | `learn/guides/fundamentals/CodebaseOverview.md` | `grep -rl Neo.setupClass src --include='*.mjs' \| wc -l` + `node ./buildScripts/util/check-relative-links.mjs` |

Decision Record impact: none.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC-1 (Single Counting Rule & Refreshed Inventory):** `learn/guides/fundamentals/CodebaseOverview.md` states the `Neo.setupClass` counting rule and updates "Understanding the Scale" and §"Component Library (The Batteries)" to the verified `dev` inventory (`459` classes in `39` namespaces, `26` form field types, `38` grid classes including header groups, `44` dashboard docking classes, `28` calendar classes, `8` layouts, `38` main-thread addons).
- [ ] **AC-2 (Single-Source Links):** `learn/benefits/body/ApplicationEngine.md` and `learn/benefits/body/Features.md` link `CodebaseOverview.md` for the per-family breakdown rather than duplicating separate family tables.
- [ ] **AC-3 (Link & Whitespace Integrity):** `node ./buildScripts/util/check-relative-links.mjs` and `node ./buildScripts/util/check-whitespace.mjs` pass with `0` errors.

## Out of Scope

Hand-editing `apps/portal/sitemap.xml` or `apps/portal/llms.txt`.

## Avoided Traps

- Counting `_export.mjs` barrel files or `form/field/trigger/*` classes as top-level classes/field types (`#20518#issuecomment-6700350274`).
